description.describe_ch: 本銜接課程在橋接理論與實際及知識與學術的距離，透過以成果導向的實務演練，充實學習者在運用學識至最佳實作的人資培育和營運管理，提升教學服務的品質管理與競爭力，以落實學能基礎和就業潛力。
description.describe_eh: This course is aimed to introduce the soft power, supplementary culture and climate within organizational context by providing students with basic conceptual framework for operating organizational performance at three different levels and models. The ethical, legal, economic, moral and professional considerations incurred by the respective organization may result in diverse effects desired by its own culture formed. Such topics as nature, typologies, change, and development will be subject to organizational capacity and capability generated from organizational function, structure, and process. Cross-cultural perspectives might be made with different philosophies along a corporate social responsibility and so on.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1.	Welcome to this course with a happy mindset, prepare yourself enough to inspire personal learning performance objects, and join to this class for promoting the outcome-based learning. 
2.	Occasionally, once you are in the low spirit, remember to taking an allowed short nap to cheer-up again and again. 
3.	The teaching course sessions welcome to asking questions or submit any suggestion, as long as it does not violate university regulations. A short break during the session will be permissible necessarily adjusted according to the needs of the majority of students.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: Course handouts and further readings will be updated and available for your studying, please check it whenever your time is available.
